landmarks.name: Crownhold
landmarks.desc: A giant concentric castle on the crag: two rings of walls, 24 towers, 46 m keep.

landmarks.name: The Crown Tower
landmarks.desc: The 46 m great keep, seven storeys, seat of the Crown.

landmarks.name: Great Hall of the Kings
landmarks.desc: Where the court feasts and the king hears petitions.

landmarks.name: The Crowning Stone
landmarks.desc: A prehistoric stone carried up from the henge: every monarch is crowned on it.

landmarks.name: King's Gate
landmarks.desc: Great gatehouse with twin 30 m drum towers and a walled barbican.

landmarks.name: City wall & seven gates
landmarks.desc: 46 towers, seven gatehouses and two water gates where the River Wend passes under chains.

landmarks.name: The Hallowstones
landmarks.desc: A 420 m henge, 4,000 years older than the city: ditch, bank and 150 standing stones.

landmarks.name: The Cove
landmarks.desc: Three giant stones at the heart of the North Circle; oaths are sworn here.

landmarks.name: The Obelisk
landmarks.desc: The tallest stone of the South Circle, the city's midsummer sundial.

landmarks.name: The Serpent Avenue
landmarks.desc: Two rows of stones winding 600 m from the henge to the river.

landmarks.name: Wardenhouse - YOUR HOUSE
landmarks.desc: Home of The Warden of the Stones, keeper of the ancient stones. Start here.

landmarks.name: The Giant's Barrow
landmarks.desc: A 120 m chambered long barrow, the tomb of the 'giant' the city's tales remember.

landmarks.name: The Druids' Row
landmarks.desc: Thirteen stones in a dead-straight line pointing at the midwinter sunrise.

landmarks.name: The Three Kings' Table
landmarks.desc: A portal tomb on the Minster lawn; three kings' bones are said to lie beneath.

landmarks.name: The Field of Mounds
landmarks.desc: Seven Bronze Age burial mounds kept as a public meadow.

landmarks.name: The Grand Market
landmarks.desc: A 260 x 120 m square with 150 stalls, fountains and the Needle at its heart.

landmarks.name: The Needle
landmarks.desc: A 9 m prehistoric menhir left standing in the market: deals are sealed by touching it.

landmarks.name: The Cloth Hall & Belfry
landmarks.desc: Vast cloth market with an 84 m belfry, the tallest tower in the city.

landmarks.name: The Great Guildhall
landmarks.desc: Seat of the city council and the twelve great guilds.

landmarks.name: The King's Column
landmarks.desc: A 32 m column topped by the first king, facing the stones he swore to protect.

landmarks.name: Haymarket
landmarks.desc: Carters and hay wains from the northern farms.

landmarks.name: Fish Market
landmarks.desc: Fresh catch straight off the boats at King's Quay.

landmarks.name: Corn Market
landmarks.desc: Grain market on the south bank, by the Old Bridge.

landmarks.name: The Old Bridge
landmarks.desc: A 150 m stone bridge of 19 arches carrying 28 shops and houses and a chapel.

landmarks.name: Mill Bridge
landmarks.desc: Seven arches with three corn mills hung off its side.

landmarks.name: King's Quay
landmarks.desc: Warehouses, treadwheel cranes and sea-going cogs on the River Wend.

landmarks.name: Stonehallow Minster
landmarks.desc: Gothic cathedral 200 m long; its spire reaches 120 m, the tallest thing in the realm.

landmarks.name: The Queen's Maze
landmarks.desc: A 60 m hedge maze; at its heart a sundial stone.

landmarks.name: The Queen's Gardens
landmarks.desc: Royal pleasure gardens: parterres, ponds, lime avenues and the summer palace.

landmarks.name: King's Park
landmarks.desc: Ancient woodland kept wild inside the walls, with deer, a mere and the barrow.

landmarks.name: Collegium of the Seven Stars
landmarks.desc: Two colleges, a great library and the Physic Garden of healing herbs.

landmarks.name: Hospital of St. Brigid
landmarks.desc: Infirmary, almshouse and herb garden run by the Brigidine sisters.

landmarks.name: Whitecross Abbey
landmarks.desc: Benedictine abbey whose monks first wrote down the legends of the stones.

landmarks.name: Greyfriars
landmarks.desc: A friary of preaching brothers.

landmarks.name: Blackfriars
landmarks.desc: A friary of preaching brothers.

landmarks.name: Cattle Fair
landmarks.desc: Livestock fair outside the gate every Thursday.

landmarks.name: Horse Fair
landmarks.desc: Livestock fair outside the gate every Thursday.
